subject: Re: Helix Health VPC packaging & support concession
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@helixhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Helix Health Procurement <procurement@helixhealth.com>, Helix Health Legal <legal@helixhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Helix VPC packaging questions + pilot concession request

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the unified private deployment options. Procurement and Legal asked me to get a clearer picture of two things before we move to an LOI:

1) Platform fee amortization — can Redwood amortize the platform fee across a 24-month ramp rather than billing upfront? Helix prefers predictable monthly charges for budgeting.
2) Support tiers — we need a clear mapping of response times and on‑call coverage for a multisite hospital deployment. Can you provide a concise matrix (P1/P2/P3, SLA credits)?

Separately, given this will start as a 6-month pilot across 3 sites, Procurement is asking whether Redwood can offer a pilot concession (one-time discount or implementation credit) in exchange for a 12–18 month committed conversion if the pilot meets the MOP. Legal will also need mutual action plan and standard SOW to review.

Can you send a short written proposal + an initial pricing worksheet we can share internally?

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a 30-min call this week if that helps.

Best,
Olivia
Olivia Park
Head of Platform Integrations | Helix Health
olivia.park@helixhealth.com
+1 415-555-0123
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Helix VPC packaging questions + pilot concession request

Olivia —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick summary of what we can do and a couple of options for Helix to consider:

Option A — Pilot concession (recommended for conversion):
- One-time implementation credit equal to 15% of month 1 estimated spend applied to the pilot invoice.
- Platform fee amortized over 18 months (monthly amortized charge) with a 12‑month minimum conversion commitment.
- Support: Standard Enterprise tier (P1: 1 hour, P2: 4 hours, P3: 24 hours) with a dedicated onboarding SRE during pilot (included).

Option B — Minimal concession (lower risk for Redwood):
- 8% implementation credit for pilot.
- Platform fee amortized over 24 months but with a 6‑month non-cancellable minimum on conversion.
- Support: Enterprise tier; onboarding SRE at separate retainer.

We can flex the pilot credit vs. amortization term depending on procurement priorities. I attached a one‑page pricing worksheet (v1) and an outline of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) in doc form — use these to validate numbers with your finance and legal teams.

If these look broadly right, can we set a fast follow for Wed/Thu? I can bring Marissa (commercial lead) and David (solutions/packaging) to nail the SKU details.

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Helix VPC packaging questions + pilot concession request

Team — forwarding Helix's ask. Quick thoughts and where I need alignment before I finalize the reply: 

1) Pilot concession level — I suggested 15% in Option A to shortcut approval, but legal will push back on too-high credits without a conversion guarantee. Would you accept 12% if we require a 12‑month conversion commit?

2) Platform fee amortization — Marissa, finance prefers 18 months for amortization from our side (less P&L churn) but Helix asked for 24. Can we offer 18 months with a 24-month equivalent cashflow option (i.e., slightly higher monthly charge but convertible)?

3) Support retainer — David, recommend including a 3-month onboarding SRE in pilot (free) but charge a modest on-call retainer after pilot unless they convert. This preserves SRE capacity. Thoughts on dollar amount for retainer ($15k/mo?)

I plan to propose a middle ground: 12% one-time pilot credit + 18-month amortization of platform fee (monthly), with a 12-month conversion commitment to unlock the credit and waive the post-pilot retainer. If legal still needs stronger guardrails, use MAP + DocuSign to lock commitments.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4721

-Marcus

Subject: Updated offer: Helix pilot concession + amortization proposal

Olivia —

Following internal alignment, here is a concise offer Helix can take to Procurement and Legal. This is structured to balance Helix budgeting preferences and Redwood's risk: 

Summary offer (pilot -> conversion):
- Pilot concession: one-time implementation credit equal to 12% of month 1 estimated pilot spend, applied to pilot invoice. Credit is earned if Helix executes a conversion LOI within 30 days of pilot completion.
- Platform fee amortization: amortized monthly over 18 months by default. If Helix requires a 24-month spread for budget purposes, we can provide a 24-month cashflow alternative which increases the monthly amortization by ~8% (details in attached pricing sheet).
- Support: Enterprise SLA during pilot (P1: 1 hour response, P2: 4 hours, P3: 24 hours) with a dedicated onboarding SRE during the first 90 days included. Post-pilot, the onboarding SRE charge is waived if Helix signs a 12-month conversion agreement.
- Exit protection: We will include a limited exit protection clause in the SOW for the pilot (30-day notice for decommissioning) to satisfy procurement.

Attachments: Redwood_VPC_Prices_v2.xlsx (detailed SKU-level pricing & amortization scenarios), Helix_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf (MAP + milestones). I also included a DocuSign stub for a 12‑month conversion LOI if you want to move quickly: https://docusign.com/heliX-hb-4721

Next steps:
1) Review with Procurement/Legal — call if any redlines on MAP/SOW.
2) If the terms are acceptable, happy to run a 30-minute alignment tomorrow (Thu) to lock SKU counts and finalize the pilot invoice.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
